upgrades.text: Gain **+1d4** to DEX and AGI saves.

spells.name: Enchant Weapon: Focus
spells.body:
As a *Half Action* enchant your weapon for your next **3** attacks/spell casts. Gain the following effects while enchanted depending on the weapon type:

**Melee**: Enchanted Melee attacks gain **+1d8** to Attack rolls. Increase by **+1d8** at Player Level 9 and 18.

**Ranged**: Enchanted Ranged attacks gain **+1d6** to Attack rolls. Increase by **+1d6** at Player Level 9 and 18.

**Spell Focus**: Enhance spells gain **+4m** to range. Enchanted Spell Attacks again **+1d8** to Attack rolls. Increase by **+1d8** at Player Level 9 and 18.
